name: KH RNA binding domain containing, signal transduction associated 2
pathways: regulation of alternative mRNA splicing, via spliceosome

function.text: KHDRBS2 encodes KH domain-containing, RNA-binding, signal transduction-associated protein 2. Annotated molecular activities include mRNA binding and poly(A) binding. It participates in regulation of alternative mRNA splicing, via spliceosome.
